features.title: Architectural Integrity
features.subtitle: We replace legacy clutter with a streamlined, modular architecture that scales with your production demands.
features.realtime.desc: Connect every sensor, machine, and workstation into a single source of truth without the latency of traditional middleware.
features.security.desc: Military-grade encryption for proprietary industrial processes and trade secrets.
features.compliance.desc: Ready for LGPD, GDPR, and ISO 27001 out of the box.
features.modular.desc: Plug-and-play modules for logistics, finance, and human resources tailored for Smar systems.
engineered.title: Engineered for the Uncompromising.
engineered.subtitle: We don't just build software; we build the digital nervous system for your factory floor. Every line of code is optimized for reliability.
engineered.unified.desc: Every department operates on the same latency-free core, eliminating data silos and synchronization errors.
engineered.predictive.desc: Our AI engine forecasts maintenance needs before failures occur, saving thousands in unplanned downtime.
engineered.api.desc: Seamlessly integrate with existing legacy hardware and modern cloud services via our robust documentation.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This page describes how Smarnet handles personal data and cookies in this environment, in accordance with Brazil's LGPD (Law 13.709/2018).
privacy.controller.title: Controller
privacy.controller.body: Processing is carried out by Smar in the Smarnet ERP, for industrial operations, master data, and authentication of authorized staff and partners.
privacy.data.title: Data we process
privacy.data.body: When you sign in, we process login credentials, operational binding (employee id, company), and the business data of the screens you use. The public site does not require an account.
privacy.cookies.title: Cookies
privacy.cookies.intro: We use cookies and local storage only for the purposes below. Optional cookies are stored only after you choose in the banner.
privacy.cookies.necessary: Signed session cookie (sessionid), required for login, authorization, and account protection.
privacy.cookies.functional: smarnet:locale, smarnet:theme, smarnet:view:*, and sidebar:state, to remember language, appearance, and layout.
privacy.rights.title: Your rights
privacy.rights.body: You may request access, correction, deletion, information about processing, and withdraw consent for optional cookies at any time with the button below.
